  • Method Details

    • parseCamera

      static Camera parseCamera(Element root, Scene scene)
      Parses the camera element and builds a Camera.

      Supported XML format: 

      
<camera
     location="0 0 1000"
     target="0 0 0"
     up="0 1 0"
     vp-width="200"
     vp-height="200"
     vp-distance="1000"
     nX="500"
     nY="500"/>
      Parameters:
      root - root scene element
      scene - parsed scene
      Returns:
      built camera

    • applyDirection

      private static void applyDirection(Camera.Builder builder, Element cameraElement, Vector up)
      Applies the camera direction.

      The XML can define either:

      • target="x y z" for setDirection(Point, Vector)
      • to="x y z" for setDirection(Vector, Vector)
      Parameters:
      builder - camera builder
      cameraElement - camera XML element
      up - up vector
